subject.title: feat: add guarded FakeCo AWS owner

question: Must this PR complete its authenticated FakeCo AWS lifecycle proof before merge, or may the feature owner explicitly waive that item-specific gate?
rationale: Static tests cannot settle real member-account policy evaluation, private networking, resource lifecycle, and recovery behavior; access to the protected environment and acceptance of residual risk require owner intent.

options.title: Require live lifecycle proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted exact-head account preflight and full lifecycle evidence is posted.

options.title: Grant item-specific waiver
options.body: Merge only with an explicit feature-owner statement accepting the unverified live AWS security and recovery boundary.

recommendation.title: Require live lifecycle proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted exact-head account preflight and full lifecycle evidence is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the underlying FakeCo staging surface and are the strongest history-backed owner for its AWS extension.
